documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Letter To Shareholders Under Regulation 36(1)(B) Of SEBI (LODR), 2015

analysis.summary: Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited reported robust financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by strong domestic demand and recovery in the automotive industry, particularly the Medium & Heavy Commercial Vehicle segment. Revenue from operations increased by 16.59% to ₹24,299.30 Lakhs, and profit after tax rose by 27.26% to ₹4,579.92 Lakhs compared to the previous year. Management highlighted strategic focus on expanding value-added offerings, automation, and green energy initiatives. Additionally, the board recommended a final dividend of ₹2.5 per equity share for the financial year. Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited reported an operational revenue of ₹20,841.38 lakhs and a profit after tax of ₹3,598.22 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian automotive industry bounced back strongly after a period of uncertainty, with growth recorded across every segment.
demand_outlook.quote: After a period of uncertainty, the sector bounced back strongly, with growth recorded across every segment - a clear sign that the fundamentals of the industry remain solid and poised for sustained growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The Medium & Heavy Commercial Vehicle segment returned to positive growth after several difficult years.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging highlights was the recovery of the Medium & Heavy Commercial Vehicle (MHCV) segment, which returned to positive growth after several difficult years.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive sector demonstrated resilience with overall vehicle sales showing year-on-year growth during FY 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive sector demonstrated commendable resilience during FY 2024-25, with overall vehicle sales showing year-on-year growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The commercial vehicle segment faced volume declines due to infrastructure project delays during the general election year affecting the first nine months.
demand_outlook.quote: However, the commercial vehicle segment faced headwinds, experiencing a decline in volumes primarily due to delays in infrastructure projects during the general election year, which affected the first nine months of the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian economy is expected to grow over 7% in the upcoming year.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian economy is expected to grow over 7% in the upcoming year, mainly driven by strong public demand and resilient private consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: The push in capital expenditure and infrastructure development will sustain the growth in the auto sector.
demand_outlook.quote: The push in capital expenditure and infrastructure development will sustain the growth in the auto sector.

demand_outlook.claim: In the coming year, the industry is expected to see significant growth in the 3-wheeler segment driven by electric vehicles.
demand_outlook.quote: In the coming year, the industry is expected to see significant growth in the 3-wheeler segment, driven by the rise in electric vehicles.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial vehicles will offer added value opportunities due to new regulations.
demand_outlook.quote: Commercial vehicles will offer added value opportunities due to new regulations.

demand_outlook.claim: The bus segment is likely to experience strong growth due to increased travel, fleet purchases, and the shift to electric vehicles in public transport.
demand_outlook.quote: The bus segment is likely to experience strong growth due to increased travel, fleet purchases, and the shift to electric vehicles in public transport.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved an investment of up to ₹3 crores in Murli Solar Energy Private Limited towards sourcing green power.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with sustainability goals, the Board has approved an investment of up to `3 crores, in Murli Solar Energy Private Limited (SPV of Sunsure Energy Pvt Limited) towards sourcing green power.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested in advanced windshield preprocessing lines to handle increasing demand for high-quality, large-format windshields.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with the increasing demand for high-quality, large-format windshields, your Company has made strategic investments in advanced windshield preprocessing lines.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested in a new cutting and grinding setup to replace the old manual setup.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company has invested in a new cutting and grinding set up to replace the old manual set up which will result in utilisation resources.

margins_costs.claim: High inflationary impact from raw glass costs, rupee depreciation, and raw material price increases were partly offset by price increases.
margins_costs.quote: The high inflationary impact from raw glass costs, the rupee depreciation against dollar, high-cost imports, cost increases by almost all raw material suppliers were partly offset with price increase.

margins_costs.claim: Company sales increased by 7.7% and achieved a profit before tax of 9.9% compared to the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Consequent to this, the Company’s sales increased by 7.7% and achieved a profit before tax of 9.9% as compared to the previous financial year 2022-23.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹2.5 per share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 15, 2026, has recommended a Final Dividend of ₹2.5 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of ₹2 per equity share of ₹10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors are pleased to recommend for approval of the Members a dividend of ₹2/- per equity share of the face value of ₹10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: Directors recommended a dividend of INR 2 per equity share of face value of INR 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors are pleased to recommend for approval of the Members a dividend of ` 2/- per equity share of the face value of ` 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent INR 57.39 Lakhs towards CSR activities during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, your Company has spent ` 57.39 Lakhs towards CSR activities, which are in line with the CSR policy of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations from global financial market volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations arising from volatility in global financial markets, which may affect its financial performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced high inflationary impact from raw glass costs, rupee depreciation against the dollar, high-cost imports, and supplier cost increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The high inflationary impact from raw glass costs, the rupee depreciation against dollar, high-cost imports, cost increases by almost all raw material suppliers were partly offset with price increase.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to strengthen its market presence in electric vehicle adoption and air-conditioned cabins by supplying key customers and engaging with others.
management_commitments.quote: We have started supplying one key customer and are in discussions with others, aiming to strengthen our market presence.

management_commitments.claim: The board approved a revised investment of up to ₹2.46 crore in Radiance MH Sunshine Two Private Limited for sourcing green power upon statutory requirements completion.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 16, 2025, approved a revised investment of not exceeding ₹2.46 Crore (earlier approved investment of ₹2.45 Crore) in Radiance MH Sunshine Two Private Limited (in place of Radiance MH Sunrise Thirteen Private Limited) towards sourcing of green power.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. K.S. Gopalakrishnan was appointed as the Managing Director of the company for a period of three years effective from May 5, 2024 up to May 4, 2027.
management_commitments.quote: appointment of Mr. K.S. Gopalakrishnan (Director Identification No. 10601515) as the Managing Director of the Company for a period of three (3) years with effect from May 5, 2024 up to May 4, 2027

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Sundar Parthasarathy was appointed as an Independent Director for a term of 5 years commencing from May 5, 2024 up to May 4, 2029.
management_commitments.quote: appointed, as an Independent Director of the Company, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of 5 (five) years commencing May 5, 2024 up to May 4, 2029.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
